describe.description: The image shows a single large, muscular felid standing in profile facing to the right with its head turned slightly toward the viewer. The body is robust and low-slung with a tawny golden-brown coat that is paler cream-white on the chest, belly, chin and lower muzzle, and has faint darker striping across the back, sides and legs. The head is broad with a short muzzle, the neck and chest have a ruff of longer shaggy fur, the legs are thick and sturdy ending in large paws, and a short tail with a dark tip extends from the rear. The animal is depicted on a plain off-white background with a soft shadow beneath its feet, rendered in a detailed natural-history illustration style.

describe.description: A large powerfully built felid standing in side view with its head turned toward the viewer. It has a muscular lion-like body covered in short tawny golden-brown fur with a paler cream chest, belly and muzzle, faint dark tiger-like striping over the back and sides and bolder dark stripes on the lower legs. The head is broad with a short muzzle, the neck and chest have slightly longer ruffed fur, and it stands on four thick legs ending in large padded paws. A short thin striped tail with a dark tip protrudes behind the hind leg.
